task: Independently review all 20 candidates against ONLY the corresponding supplied model-visible input. Method identities, reference targets and other reviews are withheld. You are GPT, not a human expert. Do not search for mission answers or read coordinator/source/reference files.
scope: source_fidelity here means fidelity to provided scenario material; external literature verification and physical validity are NOT measured. Explicit synthetic ENGINEERING_ANALYSIS or quality-check logs are available scenario claims, not real experts and not automatically raw observations. Use their declared role.
rules: Review exactly 20 items; do not use reviewer diversity or majority votes as physical truth.
Check generated instruction as well as target. All material findings must identify a field path and a visible evidence ID or precise input omission.

Current-event literature and historical summaries removed from input cannot be reintroduced from memory. Missing history times means its content is withheld; a retrieval ID/status can explain the block but supplies no cause evidence.
Upstream candidate and uncalibrated scores must stay candidates/rankings; ML-E references without visible payload are not independent proof.
Physical components/mechanisms not proven may be follow-up hypotheses explicitly qualified; do not punish well-marked proposals as fabricated observations.
Executed/planned disposal requires explicit scenario log support. New suggested checks must be follow_up_actions. A logged past restart can be recorded with scope; do not claim it solved the cause.
Scores: 0 unsupported/incorrect or materially incomplete; 1 mostly supported with material omission; 2 supported, scoped, useful. Do not reduce scores for stylistic preference alone.

ACCEPT if usable unchanged for a DEV_ONLY diagnostic candidate; REVISE if concrete corrections needed; REJECT if unsafe factual fabrication/label leakage. Any critical finding requires critical_failures code.
No hidden chain of thought. Brief checkable findings only. Never invent human signatures, independent physical approval, timestamps, model API IDs or token usage.

review_record_contract.critical_failures: list of listed codes, empty allowed

findings.evidence_ref: visible ID or exact missing-field name

output_contract.model: provided configured model name; exact serving revision unavailable
